newCharacter.name: Name
newCharacter.briefPlaceholder: e.g. A twelve-year-old genius hacker in black and red, prickly on the outside, soft on the inside.
newCharacter.hintWithBrief: After you create the character, the AI writes settings from this description. You review them before applying.
newCharacter.hintEmpty: After you create the character, you go straight to the creator and start with the look.

part.descriptionPlaceholder: e.g. A brass crescent hair clip in the same material as the chest buckle.

reference.hint: This purpose is included every time you draw from now on.

settings.yamlHint: The raw character file. Saving checks the format and image references. Day to day, just use the creator.
settings.skillNotInstalled: The project Skill is attached every time you send a job. You can also install it into your Codex.
settings.notice: Text settings are written with the Codex CLI. Images can be drawn by AIDOL directly with your Codex (counts toward your ChatGPT plan), or handed to the Codex App where you press send. AIDOL never switches to the separately billed Image API.

drawWith.title: How to draw
drawWith.aidolHint: Start drawing and it just draws — no switching to the Codex App. Uses your ChatGPT plan; once that runs out, credits are used if you have them.
drawWith.codex-app: Hand off to the Codex App
drawWith.codex-appHint: AIDOL opens a new Codex App chat with the prompt filled in, and you press send.
drawWith.unavailable: Sign in to Codex with a ChatGPT account (not an API key, not the free plan) to let AIDOL draw directly.

use.label: How to use this image
use.canonHint: Face, hair, outfit and colors all follow this image. The AI won't change the design.
use.partialHint: Pick what to borrow; your settings decide the rest.
use.canonNote: Every drawing follows this design and only changes the view, pose and layout. You can unlock it on the reference image anytime.
